purpose: Prepare a fixed baseline and three additional pruning widths for hardware-measured selection on Jetson Orin Nano

pruning.method: downstream pointwise input-channel L1 weight magnitude

selection.objective: minimum repeated median model-only latency on Orin among accuracy-eligible candidates
selection.latency_ties: If differences are smaller than observed repeated-run variation, prefer higher tuning accuracy and report no reliable latency difference.

quantization.method: explicit Q/DQ post-training INT8; tool and runtime compatibility must be verified

evaluation: After hardware selection, evaluate the fixed selected model and baseline at FP32-configured, FP16-enabled and INT8 on the 654-file local evaluation collection. The 654 baseline and earlier student results were already inspected; it is not an untouched test.
limitations: Accuracy gates are project choices, not proven safety bounds. Tuning data previously inspected; checkpoint pretraining overlap, data units and physical scene independence unverified. No target latency or novelty claim until measured.
